_comment: Map select entries. 'spawn' is the label of a spawn entity in the scene. Districts of one scene are connected, so riders can skate from one to the next.

districts.name: Street Plaza
districts.desc: Marble ledges, stair sets, handrails and manual pads in the middle of town.

districts.name: Skatepark
districts.desc: Concrete park with quarter pipes, a bowl, spine, funboxes and flat rails.

districts.name: Mega Park
districts.desc: Mega ramp roll-in, huge gap and big air kickers for the biggest spins.

districts.name: Downtown
districts.desc: Tall buildings, long avenues, planter gaps and endless ledges.

districts.name: School
districts.desc: Courtyard stairs with handrails, benches, picnic tables and a basketball court.

districts.name: Industrial
districts.desc: Loading docks, containers, pipes and banks between the warehouses.

districts.name: Rooftops
districts.desc: Gap across the roofs, ride the parapets and drop back down to the street.

districts.name: Ditch
districts.desc: Long concrete drainage ditch with steep banks and hips.

districts.name: Residential
districts.desc: Quiet streets, driveways, curbs, low walls and a few hidden kickers.

districts.name: Competition Park
districts.desc: Contest course: box jump, hubba, rainbow rail and the big quarter.

districts.name: Test Lot
districts.desc: Small lot with one of each obstacle. Used by the automated tests.
